constraints.rule: Grid/flex/absolute containers must not overlap at any declared breakpoint.
Text/background contrast must meet WCAG AA (4.5:1) at every breakpoint.
Every emitted element must have a defined style at each of the case's declared breakpoints.

conflictResolution.rationale: Single claimant (hostile-abs-a) on the layout axis in this case; no contention to resolve.
Single claimant (hostile-grid-b) on the interaction axis in this case; no contention to resolve.
